blocks.text: Gravity ke asar se azadana (freely) girta hua jism uniform acceleration wali seedhi harkat (rectilinear motion) ki sab se jani pehchani misal hai. Galileo ke mutabiq khala (vacuum) mein sab cheezen acceleration due to gravity se azadana girti hain; ise g likhte hain. Is ki tajurbe se maloom qeemat SI units mein 9.8 m s⁻² hai. Matlab yeh ke mukhtalif cheezen ek hi unchai se girayi jayen to zameen par ek hi velocity se takrati hain. g ke nishan ka qaida: girte jism ke liye (jab initial velocity zero ho) g positive lete hain, aur seedha oopar phenke gaye jism ke liye (jab initial velocity zero na ho) negative.
Azadana girte jism ke liye equations of motion mein a = g rakhne se:

blocks.title: Example 2.4
blocks.problem: 1 kg mass ki lohe ki gend ek minar (tower) se girayi jati hai aur 3.34 s mein zameen par pohanchti hai. Nikalein: (a) minar ki unchai, (b) zameen se takrate waqt gend ki velocity.
steps: Gend gravity ke asar se gir rahi hai, is liye equations mein a = g rakhenge.
Diya gaya: m = 1 kg, t = 3.34 s, vi = 0 (girayi gayi hai), a = g = 9.8 m s⁻²; maloom karna hai vf aur h.
(b) Velocity, pehli equation se: vf = vi + gt = 0 + (9.8 m s⁻²)(3.34 s) = 32.7 m s⁻¹
(a) Unchai, teesri equation se: vf² - vi² = 2gh, yani (32.7 m s⁻¹)² - (0)² = 2 × 9.8 m s⁻² × h
blocks.answer: h = 54.56 m (minar ki unchai) aur vf = 32.7 m s⁻¹ (zameen se takrane ki velocity)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein (a) minar ki unchai aur (b) zameen se takrane ki velocity poochi gayi hai, lekin kitab ke hal mein velocity wale hisse par (a) aur unchai wale hisse par (b) likha hai. Pehle velocity nikalni parti hai kyun ke unchai usi se nikalti hai; is liye yahan velocity ko (b) aur unchai ko (a) likha gaya hai, sawal ke mutabiq. Jawab wahi hain: unchai 54.56 m aur velocity 32.7 m s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt: Ek helicopter 14.6 m s⁻¹ se oopar ja raha hai aur zameen se 156.8 m oopar hai jab us se ek patthar giraya jata hai. Patthar ko zameen tak pohanchne mein kitna waqt lagega?
blocks.explanation: Patthar helicopter wali oopar ki velocity le kar chalta hai. Oopar ko positive lein: vi = +14.6 m s⁻¹, a = -9.8 m s⁻², aur zameen S = -156.8 m par hai. To -156.8 = 14.6t - 4.9t², yani 4.9t² - 14.6t - 156.8 = 0. Is se t = (14.6 + √(213.2 + 3073.3))/9.8 = (14.6 + 57.3)/9.8 ≈ 7.3 s.

items: Free fall: Galileo ke mutabiq sab cheezen g = 9.8 m s⁻² se girti hain aur ek hi unchai se ek hi velocity se zameen par pohanchti hain; girte hue g positive, oopar phenkne par negative.
